about: The Construction Simulator – Titanium Edition is your perfect entry into the fascinating world of construction and heavy machinery.

This impressive package includes the Construction Simulator base game, offering more than 100 varied construction jobs, over 90 licensed machines by 24 renowned manufacturers, as well as two huge maps – each with their own extensive campaign.

In addition, the Kramer Pack, the Year 1 Season Pass, and the Year 2 Season Pass are all also part of this bundle, enhancing your exciting journey as a construction entrepreneur with even more extensive campaigns, a whole new campaign map, and…
